HomePlace.SourceString: 异象管理局禁制机动队四队

Introduction.SourceString: 在「最不像队长」票选中名列前茅的E.T.D四队队长。
Introduction.LocalizedString: The widely recognized "least captain-like captain" from ETD-4.

Content.SourceString:
异象管理局E.T.D四队队长，白藏——随性散漫，出言无状，工作摸鱼大师，麻烦制造机。
在管理局内部的神秘呗果社群中，大家正讨论「谁是E.T.D中最不像队长的队长」。
「有没有人觉得四队的白藏队长很恶趣味？？」
「把『觉得』去掉。每次我都是临睡前突然发现今天又被他捉弄了，气死我了啊啊啊啊！」
「同感。而且你去质问他还会被奉上一副笑意盈盈的面孔——嗯，感觉拳头捏得更紧了。」
…… 
居然还蛮好笑的。
一刻也没有为自己的行为而感到抱歉，即刻赶来的是白藏一气呵成的点赞与收藏。

关于四队的队长，外头的传言褒贬不一。
譬如，要留意那束银白色的长发辫子，据说那是死神的招魂幡；看似喜欢躲在队员身后装弱，实际上是借此分析对手的实力与应对策略；关键时刻很靠谱，能力很强但不滥用；喜欢吃各类面点尤其是意面，但是自己煮的话会把意面掰成两半下锅（非常没品）。以上传言基本确凿，爱来自他最亲密的队员们。

除此之外，也有些事盘踞在他们无以窥见的过去。

从最初不受待见的旁支之子，到主动踏进本家进行异能开发，少年一点点滑向他本以为美好的「深渊」。他很早就知道了「生命」的重量，轻飘飘得如羽毛一般，只要他「开口」就能吹散。有很长一段时间他都不再说任何一句话，也许是为了赎罪，也许只是单纯的畏惧。像一片落单的雏叶迷失了方向，打着转飘落，最后被一个重要的人接住……那里就是归宿吧。

言语是恶诅，还是祝祷？他能轻易地湮灭生命，却无法留住什么。于是，他只能继续向前走。
从夏至冬，从春到秋，秋叶于败落前黄了最后一处经脉，仍坚韧地挂于树梢。
于五色为白，序属归藏——「秋」，即白藏。
Content.LocalizedString:
Captain of ETD-4 at the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Baicang—carefree, irreverant, blunt to a fault, master of dodging work, and a walking troublemaker.
In a certain hidden internal Bagel forum in the Bureau, a heated discussion unfolds: "Who's the least captain-like captain among ETD?"
"Am I the only one who thinks Captain Baicang from Squad 4 has a twisted sense of humor???"
"You're not alone. Every night, before I fall alseep, I realize the pranks he pulled on me at work. You have no idea how much that disrupts my sleep."
"Same here. And when you confront him about it, he just gives you this smiling face… ugh, makes me want to clench my fists even tighter."
…
It's actually pretty funny.
With zero remorse for his antics, Baicang swoops in to gleefully like and save every comment.

Rumors about Squad 4's captain are mixed.
For instance, "Watch out for that long silver-white braid, for it's the Reaper's banner." "He seems to like hiding behind his team members and playing weak, but he's actually analyzing his opponents' strength and countermeasures." "He's reliable when it counts, very capable, and doesn't abuse his power." "He loves all kinds of pasta, especially Italian, but when he cooks it himself he breaks the noodles in half before putting them in the pot (absolutely tasteless)." All these rumors are basically true, confirmed with love from his closest team members.

Beyond that, things lurk in his past that they cannot see.

From an unwanted branch family child to voluntarily entering the main house for Esper Ability development, the young man gradually slipped toward what he thought was a beautiful "abyss." He learned early the weight of life: Light as a feather. Something he could blow away just by speaking. For a long time he stopped saying anything at all, perhaps to atone, perhaps simply from fear. He was like a lone young leaf that had lost its way, spinning as it fell, until finally caught by someone important… that was when he found his home.

Are words curses or prayers? He can easily extinguish life, yet cannot preserve anything. Thus, he can only keep moving forward.
From summer to winter, from spring to fall, the veins of fall leaves turn yellow, still clinging to the branches before finally falling.
In the system of the Five Colors, white is associated with Gui Cang and the season of autumn, giving rise to the name White Cang or Baicang.

Content.SourceString:
「旁支」并不受人待见。
白藏从儿时起就学会了顺从的垂首和恰当好处的示弱——可这样就足够了吗？不想再弯下脊椎、不想再被本家的孩子们嘲笑。他能听到这片死寂之下，亲眷们对力量的哀叹与渴望。母亲身体不好，每每关节作痛，都会皱起隐忍的眉。他唯一能做的，不过是用自己微小的能力改变母亲关节处最上层的皮肤状态，让那里柔软、暖和一些。
「要是能变强就好了。这样就能保护所有人。」
在得知「变强」唯一的的途径后，小小少年下定决心，麻利地收拾好行囊，搬进了本家。
Content.LocalizedString:
Branch families aren't well-liked.
From childhood, Baicang learned to bow his head obediently and show weakness at just the right moments. But was that really enough? He didn't want to bend over anymore; he didn't want to be mocked by the main family's children. He could hear beneath the deathly silence in his relatives' laments and longing for power. His mother's health was poor, but whenever her joints ached, she would simply furrow her brow quietly. The only thing he could do was use his weak Esper Ability to change the topmost layer of skin around her joints, making it softer and warmer.
"If only I could become stronger. Then I could protect everyone."
After learning the only way to become stronger, the small boy made up his mind, quickly packed his belongings, and moved into the main house.

Content.SourceString:
生命在他的言语之下消逝得这样轻飘飘，好像一场幻梦。他也处在这幻梦中吗？只是一味抱着「变强」的想法，他被迫重复着煎熬的行为。能从对面的瞳孔中看到自己倒映的面孔……那个少年为何露出这样悲伤、迷茫的神色？
后来很长一段时间，他都不再开口说话。言语是「恶诅」，他曾这样确信。
直到遇见老师，他意识到即便没有异能，言语仍然蕴含力量。有时候，一句简短的话就能解开一个人一生的心魔与症结。
「深渊的出口通向哪里，只有跳进去才知道吧。」
于是他收起胆怯，跳进恶诅与祝祷的深壑。
Content.LocalizedString:
Life fades away so lightly under his words, like a dream. Is he also a prisoner in that dream? Blindly clinging to the ideal of strength, he was once forced to take life, to repeat this agonizing behavior. He could see his own face reflected in their pupils… Why did that young man bear such a sad, confused expression?
For a long time after, he stopped speaking entirely. Words were curses—he was certain of that.
It wasn't until he met his teacher that he realized that even without Esper Abilities, words still held power. Sometimes, a single short sentence could untangle a person's lifelong demons and troubles.
"Where will the abyss lead? You only know by jumping in."
So he put away his fear and jumped into the chasm that exists between curses and prayers.

Content.SourceString:
像是新生的婴儿，一开始只能说几个字眼，然后是语句。
仿佛与几年前逐渐噤声的自己背道而驰，他哭、笑、大喊大叫，极尽所能地感受喉间的震动。
他将用声音铭刻自己。言语是他缠附的诅咒、祝祷、力量，也是他必须背负的宿命。
重新掌握言语时，他才算真正获得了新生。
Content.LocalizedString:
Like a newborn baby, at first he could only say a few words, then sentences.
Completely opposite to his gradual descent into silence from years before, he again began to cry, laugh, and shout. He reveled in feeling the vibrations in his throat as much as possible.
He would carve himself with sound. Words were his clinging curses, blessings, and power, as well as the destiny he had to bear.
When he finally regained mastery over words, he achieved true rebirth.

Content.SourceString:
管理局的下午茶整体质量不错，但最近上新的糯米团子还有改进空间；他已经能好好开口说话了，甚至有些嘴欠过头，不过盘算了一下这个事儿得怪老师；最近和同伴的相处似乎有些变化，偶尔会冒出「原来自己有被理解」的念头；很久都没见到之前那位猎人搭档，不知道他最近怎么样；关于那枚戒指，他其实早知道那只是一个心理暗示……
可最终他什么也没能说出口，就像他们初识时那样。
对着墓茔，「哑巴孩子」轻轻抬了抬手中的酒。
——敬这月色，老师。
Content.LocalizedString:
The Bureau's afternoon tea is pretty good overall, but the new rice dumplings could use some improvement. He can speak properly now; maybe he even talks too much. After giving it some thought, he blames his teacher for that. Things with his teammates seem different lately, and sometimes he gets the feeling that he's actually understood. He hasn't seen that hunter partner in a while, and wonders how he's doing. About that ring, he always knew it was just psychological suggestion…
But in the end, he couldn't say anything at all, just like when they first met.
Facing the grave, the "mute child" gently raised the drink in his hand.
To this moonlight, teacher.

Content.SourceString:
有时候，他几乎都以为自己过的是和寻常打工人一样的生活。
但夜晚的噩梦总会让他惊醒过来。
他会走向自己预想的终点吗？
直到查明一切，直到悲剧不再上演，直到偿还所有过错——要是能够不留遗憾就好了。
Content.LocalizedString:
Sometimes, he almost thinks he's living the same life as any ordinary office worker.
But the nightmares always wake him up at night.
Will he reach the end he's imagining for himself?
Until everything is uncovered, until tragedy stops repeating, until all mistakes are repaid… If only he could leave no regrets behind…

Content.SourceString: 你我都有过命的交情了，那些繁文缛节就免了吧？嗯……不过细细一想，确实没来得及好好介绍自己。E.T.D四队队长白藏——今后也让我们继续友好相处吧~
Content.LocalizedString: We've been through life and death together, so let's skip all the formalities, shall we? Hmm… but, come to think of it, I think I've never properly introduced myself… Captain, ETD-4—The name's Baicang. Let's continue getting along well, shall we?

Content.SourceString: 认真固然是优点，但总绷紧弦面对一切可是很累的。作为朋友提醒你，偶尔还是该放松一下~
Content.LocalizedString: Being serious is a virtue, sure, but tensing up all the time is more exhausting than it ever needed to be! Here's some advice as a friend—you should loosen up once in a while!

Content.SourceString: 你问我怎么在这儿？呃……如你所见，被法帝娅和小弥撒锁在外面啦。唉，怎么对自家队长如此无情……嗯？「白藏又怎么捉弄人了」？好过分啊，怎么连你也默认是我的错？虽然确实是我在睡着的小弥撒脸上画了胡子，但法帝娅也帮她「报复」回来了啊！现在还把我赶到外面，这量刑也太重了吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Wondering why I'm out here? Uh… as you can see, I've been locked outside by Fadia and Mosa. Sigh… How could they be so heartless to their own Captain… Hm? "What did you do this time?" Hey, you're being a little unfair to me, don't you think? Even you assume it's my fault? I mean, I did draw a mustache on Mosa's face while she was sleeping… but! Fadia already made us even! Yet they still locked me outside after that! That can't be a fair trial and punishment…

Content.SourceString: 你在伊波恩似乎待得挺开心，看来那位待你不薄嘛。不过——要是什么时候想投奔管理局了，我们E.T.D的大门也随时为你敞开哦。
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like you're having a good time in Eibon. Seems like she likes you enough. But… if you ever fancy a change of scenery, our doors at ETD are always open for you.

Content.SourceString: 天气这么好，闷在局里写文书多浪费啊？嗯，任务就之后再说吧~
Content.LocalizedString: Why waste such a beautiful day cooped up in the office doing paperwork? Yup! I'll deal with that later.

Content.SourceString: 想打发时间的话，可以在雨天观察一下屋瓦，很有趣哦~泛着和平时不一样的流光，水点从不同的角度弹跳起来，发出频率不一的声音……像是有人在倾诉什么。
Content.LocalizedString: If you're looking to kill time, try watching roof tiles in the rain. It's quite fascinating. They shimmer differently than usual, with water droplets bouncing from different angles, creating sounds of different frequencies… almost like someone is trying to whisper something.

Content.SourceString: 我提议给四队放「低温假」，除了翳以外全票通过。可惜，亲爱的局长大人还是驳回了。唉，你要是有「低温假」或者「寒假」这种东西，就替我好好享受吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I proposed introducing "days off for cold weather" for my squad. Which passed unanimously… except for Skia's vote. Then, our dear Director rejected it. Ah well, if you've got any "cold weather days off" or "winter breaks" where you're from, do enjoy them on my behalf.

Content.SourceString: 为了奖励在大热天勤恳工作的自己，我准备绕路去碎雪买个冰淇淋。嘘，别告诉翳……嗯？这可不能算偷懒！但是作为保密的谢礼，也帮你捎一个吧~说吧，要什么口味？
Content.LocalizedString: To reward myself for my diligent effort working under this scorching heat! I'm planning to take a detour and buy some ice cream from Blizzi. Shh, don't tell Skia… Hm? Hey, this isn't slacking off! But, as thanks for keeping my secret, I'll grab one for you too! So, what flavor would you like?

Content.SourceString: 早啊~明媚的清晨，多适合悠哉度过……哎，可不能让他们发现我，先走一步咯。
Content.LocalizedString: Morning! Such a lovely day, perfect for taking it easy… Ah, better not let them find me though. See ya.

Content.SourceString: 你来得正巧。午休时间我打算去喝杯茶，要不要一起？
Content.LocalizedString: Perfect timing. I was just about to grab some tea during my lunch break. Care to join me?

Content.SourceString: 无惊无险，又到饭点……可惜，一会儿还有任务要办，晚餐只能将就一下喽。
Content.LocalizedString: Smooth sailing 'til meal time! …Unfortunately, I've got an assignment soon… so dinner better be quick and simple.

Content.SourceString: 已经困了吗？哦……这个时间是该休息了。聊得兴起，不知不觉就把你留到这么晚，抱歉抱歉~
Content.LocalizedString: Getting sleepy? Oh… I suppose it is that time of night already. I got so caught up in our chat that I kept you here for too long without realizing. My bad, my bad.

Content.SourceString: 如果午休时在休息室里装死，大家看到后会露出什么表情……你难道不好奇吗？我一会儿就去试试，你要不要来扮演「命案」的第一发现人？
Content.LocalizedString: Don't you ever wonder what kind of face people would make if they found me playing dead in the break room during lunch break? Hahaha! Actually, I'm gonna try it in a bit. Why don't you become the discoverer of my "body"?

Content.SourceString: 只要什么事都不在乎，就没有任何事好烦恼——哈哈，不要露出那种表情嘛，我可没说我没有烦恼。只不过，暂时还是让我保留一些秘密吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Care less, worry less! Hah, don't give me that look! I never said I had no worries. Let me keep some secrets to myself for now, alright?

Content.SourceString: 虽说言语是心灵的载体，但对于真正想传达的事物，即使没有巴别塔，人们也一定能找到方法表达。文字、动作、表情……不觉得解读这一切很有趣吗？比如说，你看，现在翳的表情就是……呃，发现我昨天擅自翘班没走流程……
Content.LocalizedString: They say language is vessels of the mind, but when people want to convey something, people will always find ways to express themselves, Tower of Babel or not. Words, actions, expressions… Don't you find interpreting them fascinating? Say, look—Skia's expression right now is… uh, he found out I skipped work yesterday…

Content.SourceString: 休假就该随心所欲，来一场心血来潮的赴约！我的话——喝喝茶啦、逛逛新开的蛋糕店啦、和花店的老板交流一下种植小知识啦、找故人说说话啦……对了，山脚的墓园旁有一处林地很漂亮。傍晚时，风儿在身上流动……很舒服。
Content.LocalizedString: Vacations are all about following your whims and making spontaneous plans! For me—sipping tea, checking out that new cake shop, trading gardening tips with the florist, catching up with old friends… Oh, and there's this beautiful forest near the cemetery at the foot of the mountain. In the evening, when the breeze flows over your skin… It feels good.

Content.SourceString: 偶尔我会想，如果逝去的事物都失去了历史和名字，那还剩些什么？曾说过的言语、澎湃的情感会随之消散吗？迟来的太阳——也会对枯萎的向日葵说「对不起」吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes I wonder, if everything that's gone loses its history and name, what remains? The ideas they had, the emotions they experienced… Where do they go? Would a late sun apologize to a withered sunflower…?

Content.SourceString: 言语的力量比人们想象中要强大得多。哈哈，很可怕吧？在欲念的驱使下，再平平无奇的话语也能轻易地制造苦难或幸福。不过，你一定是那种能够善用这份力量的人吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Words hold far more power than people realize. Scary, isn't it? Haha… With desire, even the most ordinary words can easily bring suffering or happiness. But, I'm sure you know how to use this power wisely.

Content.SourceString: 想听听过去的事？难得碰到你这样有好奇心的人。嗯……让我想想从哪里开始讲好呢？这样吧：很久很久以前，一个年轻人在海边捡到了一个本应只在神话故事里出现的生物，后世认为那就是海特洛最早为人所知的异象……嗯？你不是想听这个？
Content.LocalizedString: The past? It's rare to meet someone as curious as you. Hmm… where should I begin? How about this: Long, long ago, a young man found a creature by the sea that should only have existed in myths… What later generations would consider the earliest anomaly in Hethereau… Hm? Not the past you were looking for?

Content.SourceString: 「队长」这种头衔，其实没什么意义。我呢，也不是什么爱摆架子的人；他们几个呢，也不会因为虚头巴脑的称谓就敬我几分。要我说，当队长尽是些麻烦事——说起这个，明早局里的会议，还得想个借口让翳替我去……
Content.LocalizedString: Titles like "Captain" don't really mean much anyway. Me, I'm not one for putting on airs, and my team? They aren't going to respect me more just because I have some title. If you ask me, being captain is nothing but a hassle—speaking of which, I need to come up with an excuse to make Skia attend the Bureau's meeting tomorrow morning in my place…

Content.SourceString: 按局长大人扣我工资的力度，迟早有一天我要贷款上班。哎呀~这么一说，还真是好奇她究竟什么时候才会把我扫地出门呢。
Content.LocalizedString: At the rate the Director's docking my pay… Sooner or later, I'll need a loan just to come to work. Ahh… Now I'm wondering when she will actually kick me out.

Content.SourceString: 别看翳长得凶神恶煞，他对待工作可是很认真的。哈哈，副队可靠，我作为队长也乐得轻松——当然，要是不那么严肃地对待我的小失误就更好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't let Skia's scary face fool you, he takes his work very seriously. Haha, having such a reliable Lieutenant makes my job as Captain much easier. Though, it would be nice if he wasn't so strict about my little slip-ups.

Content.SourceString: 千万别随便招惹法帝娅——这是过来人的经验之谈。不过，如果你足够自信，也不是不能试试。届时请务必让我旁观学习！你很好奇我经历了什么？哈哈……拜托拜托，这个就别问啦。
Content.LocalizedString: Never mess with Fadia unless you're prepared, take it from someone who knows better. Though, if you're feeling confident, by all means! Try your luck, and promise you'd let me watch! Curious about what happened to me? Heh… let's not get into that.

Content.SourceString: 小弥撒能力很强，但毕竟还是个不谙世事的小孩子。作为成年人，当然要多关照她一些啦。哎，她为什么总是那么讨厌我呢？真让人伤心……
Content.LocalizedString: Mosa's incredibly talented, but she's still just a kid who doesn't know much about the world. As an adult, I should look after her. Ugh, why does she hate me so much though? It really breaks my heart…

Content.SourceString: 偶尔和局长大人有些相似，让人琢磨不透的女人……不过现在看起来和当年又有些不一样了？会不会是酒喝多了导致的？
Content.LocalizedString: She sometimes reminds me of the Director—just as impossible to figure out… Though she seems different now compared to back then? Maybe she's been drinking too much?

Content.SourceString: 要是没有花里胡哨的规矩，没有那群迂腐的老古板，管理局倒也是个不坏的地方~不过，好像把这些去掉之后也不剩什么了啊。
Content.LocalizedString: The Bureau wouldn't be half bad without all those fancy rules and stuffy traditionalists. Though, I guess there wouldn't be much left after removing all that, would there?

Content.SourceString: E.T.D里都是群我行我素的的怪人。别看新闻里说得好听，实际共事起来只会让人头疼。每个人聚在一起各显神通，简直乱七八糟，像个马戏团似的。虽说确实也挺有趣……「你也是构成E.T.D风采的重要一员」？啊哈哈，谢谢谢谢。
Content.LocalizedString: ETD is just a bunch of enigmatics doing whatever they want. They look good on the news, but working with them is nothing but headaches. Everyone showing off their special talents when they're together… it's more like a circus than a workplace. Though, I'll admit it is pretty entertaining… "You're part of it"? Ahaha, why, thank you!

Content.SourceString: 「四队的队长是不是被队员孤立了」？谁说的，绝对没有这回事！我们可是局里以团结一心闻名的模范队伍……你说之前看到小弥撒、法帝娅和翳一起去广场附近逛街吃饭了？诶，什么时候的事？
Content.LocalizedString: Squad 4's Captain is being isolated by his team members…? Who said that? That's not true! We're known throughout the Bureau as a model team with unparalleled unity… Wait, you saw Mosa, Fadia, and Skia hanging out together near the plaza for shopping and dinner? Huh? When did that happen?

Content.SourceString: 偶尔前进一步也不赖嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: Taking a step forward now and then isn't so bad.

Content.SourceString: 闲云野鹤的日子要一去不复返咯~
Content.LocalizedString: Looks like my lazy days are coming to an end!

Content.SourceString: 好吧，今天也是加把劲骑士。
Content.LocalizedString: Here's to another day of hard work.

Content.SourceString: 嗯~看来我们有极其相似的高品位！
Content.LocalizedString: Aha, seems like we have the same refined taste in things!

Content.SourceString: 朋友的馈赠最暖人心……我一定要摆在进门最显眼的地方！
Content.LocalizedString: A gift from a friend is a treasure… I'll put it where everyone can see!

Content.SourceString: 礼尚往来。你的礼物……这几天我再想想。
Content.LocalizedString: A gift for a gift. My gift for you is… like me think about it.

Content.SourceString: 嘘，小点声。队长收贿这事儿，在管理局可是要被查的！
Content.LocalizedString: Psst! The Bureau won't allow its Captains to take bribes!

Content.SourceString: 哟，闲聊结束了。
Content.LocalizedString: Yo, chit-chat's over.

Content.SourceString: 竖起耳朵听好咯。
Content.LocalizedString: Perk up your ears.

Content.SourceString: 嘘——不要出声。
Content.LocalizedString: Shhh—keep quiet.

Content.SourceString: 斯言之玷，不可为也。
Content.LocalizedString: Spoken stains, must not be.

Content.SourceString: 口之宣言，谨此敬之。
Content.LocalizedString: Words spoken aloud, must be honored.

Content.SourceString: 来确认一下吧？是祝祷还是……诅咒。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's confirm it—blessing or… a curse?

Content.SourceString: 有归处总是好的~
Content.LocalizedString: Welcome to where you belong!

Content.SourceString: 收工咯。
Content.LocalizedString: Anddddd clock off.

Content.SourceString: 睡个好觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Sleep tight.

Content.SourceString: 任务报告就随便写写吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll just… scribble something on the mission report.

Content.SourceString: 就当是加班费啦。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll consider it my overtime pay.

Content.SourceString: 哦？品相倒是不错。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh? Looks like fine stuff.

Content.SourceString: 有需要的话，就尽快收起来吧。
Content.LocalizedString: In case you need it, keep it in your pocket.

Content.SourceString: 顺手的事~
Content.LocalizedString: Piece of cake!

Content.SourceString: 多多益善嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: The more, the merrier.

Content.SourceString: 唷，好东西~?
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, nice stuff!

Content.SourceString: 哎呀……真想申请中场休息啊。
Content.LocalizedString: Ahh… A time-out would be really nice now.

Content.SourceString: 差不多得认真起来了。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's get serious.

Content.SourceString: 还来——有没有搞错啊？
Content.LocalizedString: Again? Are you serious?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……呀！轻松多了。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… Ah! Much better.

Content.SourceString: 接下来就速战速决吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's get this done quickly.

Content.SourceString: 不在这里……也不在别处吗。
Content.LocalizedString: Not here… not anywhere else either…

Content.SourceString: 这一天……来得比想象中更早呢……
Content.LocalizedString: This day… came sooner than I thought…

Content.SourceString: 要是有……欢迎仪式就好了。
Content.LocalizedString: I hope… there's a welcoming ceremony for me…

Content.SourceString: 下手太重了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Was that too hard?

Content.SourceString: 赶时间下班，抱歉咯。
Content.LocalizedString: Gonna clock out! Sorry!

Content.SourceString: 啧。
Content.LocalizedString: Tsk.

Content.SourceString: 挺凶的嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: Feisty, aren't you?

Content.SourceString: 有点能耐。
Content.LocalizedString: Not bad.

Content.SourceString: ……大意了。
Content.LocalizedString: …I got careless.

Content.SourceString: 唷，需要搭把手吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, need a hand?

Content.SourceString: 放心，我不会半路开溜的~
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, I won't run away midfight.

Content.SourceString: 喂，别走神了~
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, don't space out on me!

Content.SourceString: 偶尔也该活动下筋骨。
Content.LocalizedString: I could use some exercise.

Content.SourceString: 喂喂，下手注意点轻重~
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, watch it. Don't hit too hard.

Content.SourceString: 哎呀~无远弗届呐。
Content.LocalizedString: Well, well, talk about range.

Content.SourceString: 哟，小鸟。
Content.LocalizedString: Hey there, little bird.

Content.SourceString: 换班了。
Content.LocalizedString: Shift change.

Content.SourceString: 我来吗？好吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Me? Alright then.

Content.SourceString: 小心误伤！
Content.LocalizedString: Friendly fire!

Content.SourceString: 任务报告晚点再写。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll write the mission report… later.

Content.SourceString: 猫鼠游戏还没结束。
Content.LocalizedString: The cat and mouse game isn't over.

Content.SourceString: 喂喂，有本事和成年人打。
Content.LocalizedString: Hey! Pick on someone your own size.

Content.SourceString: 后辈面前可得好好表现了~
Content.LocalizedString: Gotta put on a good show for the rookies.

Content.SourceString: 副队倒下，四队何存？喂，振作点！
Content.LocalizedString: Lieutenant down, that's it for Squad 4? Pull it together!

Content.SourceString: 那里可不是你想要的终点吧。
Content.LocalizedString: That's not the ending you wanted, right?

Content.SourceString: 小弥撒，睡觉得回家睡才行。
Content.LocalizedString: Mosa, you can sleep when we get home.

Content.SourceString: 局里真得多给点工伤报销额了。
Content.LocalizedString: We're gonna need injury compensation.

Content.SourceString: 就这点程度？
Content.LocalizedString: That's it?

Content.SourceString: 瞧好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Watch and learn.

Content.SourceString: 呼……好险~
Content.LocalizedString: Phew… that was close!

Content.SourceString: 满分操作。
Content.LocalizedString: Flawless execution.
